g.title: PSP_QSP
g.text: Progressive Supranuclear Palsy (PSP) — QSP mechanistic map
4R-tau travelling wave through the connectome · pool-size ceiling on extracellular mechanisms · reserve-gated clinical readout
: intraneuronal ~2000 nM · ISF ~1 nM · CSF ~0.01 nM | v ~ sqrt(D·k·M) | PSPRS = reserve-gated integral of neuron loss
